title: Staggered Dedicated Capacity Onboarding and Cross-functional Release Schedule
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Goal: Coordinate a staggered regional activation of new Dedicated instance families (G12x, H8y) across NA, EU, and APAC with synchronized release notes, customer comms, and cross-team tasks (billing SKU changes, console feature flags, and Dedicated telemetry).

Scope:
- Activate dedicated capacity SKUs in three regions over six weeks with staged cutovers and automated fallback.
- Produce one coordinated release notes artifact and region-specific callouts (latency expectations, supported AZs, and reservation commit window).
- Ensure Billing, Console, Support, Legal, and Infra teams have runbooks and feature-flag gating prior to each region activation.

Out-of-scope: migration automation for existing customers (handled by separate migration project), wholesale pricing renegotiation for enterprise customers (handled by Sales Ops).

Why this ticket exists: prior launches had ad-hoc comms causing support triage spikes. This ticket consolidates operational gating, release notes sequencing, and a cross-functional schedule to reduce confusion and enable safe rollouts.

2025-02-18 - Marco Delgado: Confirmed engineering capacity constraints and proposed feature-flag windows. ENG-19821 assigned for telemetry hooks. Added estimate 8 points.

2025-02-24 - Priya Shah (Billing): Identified billing SKU delta; created billing-setup checklist and sample invoice language. Requested a dry-run for invoice previews two weeks before region activation.

2025-02-28 - Legal (Tom Becker): Reviewed terms for EU data residency callouts; request: include explicit language in release notes about Private deployment KMS options. Flagged for security review if new audit logs/event types are released.

2025-03-03 - Marco Delgado: Runbook draft v0.2 uploaded to Drive (link below). Engineering completed canary tests for G12x in NA; latency SLO met at 95th percentile under expected load. Proceeding to integration tests with Console team.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes published in single canonical Confluence doc with per-region sections and legal-approved language
Billing SKUs live in billing system with invoice preview tested for three sample accounts
Console feature flag gating is implemented and verified for NA, EU, APAC in staging
Support runbook published and Support team trained (recording + FAQ)
Automated fallback to shared-hosted variants verified in chaos test
Telemetry dashboards show expected throughput and latency baselines for each SKU family
rollout_plan:
Week 1 (NA): enable G12x in us-west-2 with feature flag; 48h canary -> 7-day gradual ramp to 60% capacity.
Week 3 (EU): enable H8y in eu-central with legal-approved copy and billing SKUs activated after invoice preview. 48h canary -> 5-day ramp.
Week 5 (APAC): final gate—confirm KMS integrations and support readiness; enable with 72h canary and 14-day slow ramp for regional latency tuning.
Fallback policy: automated traffic reroute to hosted variant if error rate exceeds 2% or 95th percentile latency breaches target for >30m.
Post-launch: 30-day telemetry baseline review and customer feedback survey to top 25 early adopters.
communication_plan:
- Internal: Weekly 30-min readiness sync (product/eng/billing/ops/legal/support) until APAC activation; Slack #dedicated-ops channel for day-of coordination.
- External: Staged release notes email to affected customers 48h before region activation; in-console banner for early adopters; one scheduled webinar for sales enablement.
- Support escalation: designate an on-call triage lead from SRE for day-of and next 48h window.
risks_and_mitigations: Billing SKU mismatch could cause invoice disputes — mitigation: invoice dry-run with finance and 3 pilot accounts; hold activation until confirmed
Unexpected latency regression under multi-tenant bursts — mitigation: canary with realistic traffic, fast rollback flag, and automated fallback to hosted endpoints
Legal/regulatory nuance in EU wording — mitigation: require legal sign-off on release notes before EU activation
Support capacity overwhelmed during first 48h — mitigation: pre-recorded training, swap in additional L2s for day-of
